main_text.p: diuinus ordo Chrifti , quem nemo fine impie- tate oppugnare poteft : in republica, humanus ordo,cui nemo obfiftit fine atroce in naturam ipfam contumelia.In Ecclefia,ius ab ordine di- uino cognofcimus, ius conftantiffimů ab xter- na illa ratione proficifcens, & immutabile : In republica , iuris illius diuini habemus adiu- mentů, & poteftates adminiftras propter hunc ipfum finem à Deo datas. Atque hæc omnia in fede quadam firma & immota, id eft,in Eccle- fia,funt à Deo cóftituta: vnde adminiftros fuos iubet ordini publico & fingulis membris ad hunc ordinem. pertinentibus in fua quemque vocatione confulere, & omnes fanctificat præ- fentia fua.

Abfit igitur à nobis, fi Chriftiani fumus, fi ordinem Ecclefiæ & reipublicæ omnisque fo- cietatis humanæ diligimus , fi ius à Deo & na- turæ ordine imperatů,colimus; fi ftabile quod- dam veræ pacis & tranquillitatis domicilium appetimus : abfit , vt_difcidiis & contentioni- bus ordinem illum fanctiffimum cóturbemus, quem Deus in Ecclefia fua obfignauit , & quo obfignat Ecclefiam fuam. Abfit,vt diuifi & di- uulfi aribus violentiaq. Satanæ malimus effe, quàm in Deo vnitatis & pacis, & in catholica Ecclefia eius,vnitate fpiritus,& vnitate ordinis contineri. page.notes: Marginal notes: a small note in the left margin at the top, and a note in the right margin at the top are indistinct and could not be read reliably; they are not transcribed. Text at the head of the page reads "PARS PRIMA." in the running head with page number 157. Several words are doubtful: "diuifi & diu- uulfi" (line 2 from end of p.2) and "aribus" appear to be a printed error and are left as printed. Line-end breaks "contentioni- bus", "diuini" and "adiu- mentů" are hyphenated as printed.
